items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But Richard Davis says that he practices -- or Ron Carter, for instance, says that he practices an awful lot.

ctx.x: That's true, that's true. Like it's hard for me to play the same thing twice exactly alike. It's hard to do because I never studied that way. I've never really studied or practiced like you see some people get up and practice, half the day, half the night, and when I practice, I'm practicing while I'm working.
But Richard Davis says that he practices -- or Ron Carter, for instance, says that he practices an awful lot.
Yeah, well, those kind of cats do. I remember Richard in Chicago, way before he left, I first met him. He invited me over to his house and he had the books be-
